props.name: format
props.comment: Read transform (the files in the form → the files shown). Default makes a preview record of each dropped file.

props.name: parse
props.comment: Write transform (the dropped or remaining files → stored value). Default makes a preview record of each dropped file.

props.name: accept
props.comment:
The native `accept` attribute (a comma-separated MIME/extension list, e.g.
`"image/*,application/pdf"`). DIVERGENCE from the React twin's react-dropzone
object form — the native `<input type=file>` speaks the string form.

props.name: multiple
props.comment: Accept multiple files (the value becomes an array). Default `false`.

props.name: placeholder
props.comment: Placeholder text shown in the dropzone (overrides the default labels).

props.name: labelMultiple
props.comment: i18n key for the multiple-files prompt.

props.name: labelSingle
props.comment: i18n key for the single-file prompt.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path (dot/bracket), relative to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
